notes: Each table sits under a caption inside one absolutely positioned container, so the caption is a
text element and the table a table element — the same split the .card rule produces on a client deck
slides (a text run of in-flow blocks, then a non-text sibling).
table-layout:fixed plus a <colgroup> makes colWidthsPx a property of the CSS rather than of the
text, so the expected widths below are exact.
Spans are counted once, at their origin cell: a rowSpan 2 cell appears in the cells list only for
the row it starts in, which is why t1 has 17 cells and not 19.

gateMaxPx2 60 = max(measured x 1.2, measured + 60) over the measured 0 px2 masked non-chart area on fidelity-w3 (2314d7f), 2026-09-25 (plan §11; Peter #16: measured + 20 %, with the 60 px2 per-slide noise tolerance as the floor). A regression guard, not a target.
